title: Adversary
description: Defines any non-player character (NPC) with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced progression systems.

name.description: The display name of the adversary.

era.description: The primary era this adversary is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: How common or unique this adversary is in the galaxy.

tags.description: UNIVERSAL TAGGING SYSTEM (Genesis Protocol Article II): Static tags that define this adversary's nature, affiliations, and combat style. All tags must be defined in master_tags.yml. Examples: ['sith', 'force_user', 'ruthless', 'empire_loyalist'].

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the adversary, their role, and significance. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this adversary, often from Star Wars lore.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this adversary is viewed by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Detailed mechanical and lore description of the adversary.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this adversary in the galaxy.

tier.description: The tier of the NPC, which determines their role and how they function.

character_sheet_id.description: Reference to the adversary's character sheet file (e.g., 'character_stormtrooper_sergeant')

personal_name.description: The adversary's personal name (e.g., 'TK-421' for a stormtrooper)

special_rules.description: Special rules for this NPC, e.g., 'As a companion, this character acts on the player's turn'.

ai_behavior.description: Adversary-specific AI behavior and combat tactics

combat_tactics.description: Specific combat tactics and strategies this adversary uses

target_priorities.description: What this adversary prioritizes as targets

retreat_conditions.description: Conditions under which this adversary will retreat

escalation_triggers.description: What causes this adversary to escalate their tactics

combat_role.description: The primary combat role of this adversary.

threat_level.description: The threat level this adversary poses to players.

loot_table.description: Items and rewards this adversary can drop

guaranteed_loot.description: Items always dropped by this adversary

random_loot.description: Items that may be dropped by this adversary

rare_loot.description: Rare items that may be dropped by this adversary

encounter_guidance.description: Guidance for using this adversary in encounters

solo_encounter.description: How to use this adversary as a solo encounter

group_encounter.description: How to use this adversary in group encounters

environmental_factors.description: Environmental factors that affect this adversary

allies_and_minions.description: Common allies and minions for this adversary

narrative_tags.description: Tags for categorizing and filtering adversaries
